title: kbmon's fast_forward names an untracked file the incoming commits add as what stops the fast-forward
goal: the sprint panel's fast_forward gives can false and names the path when an untracked file in the checkout is one the commits it is behind add, as git merge --ff-only refuses then

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();w=os.path.join(t,'wt');ok=False
for n in range(2,80):
    add=s.run(['git','diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=A','origin/main~%d'%n,'origin/main'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
    if add:break
s.run(['git','worktree','add','-q','--detach',w,'origin/main~%d'%n],check=True,capture_output=True)
try:
    p=os.path.join(w,add[0]);os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True);open(p,'w').write('untracked\n')
    q=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','sprint','--root',w],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
    ff=json.loads(q.stdout)['panels']['sprint']['data'].get('fast_forward') or {};print(q.returncode,ff,add[0])
    ok=ff.get('can') is False and add[0] in str(ff.get('why'))
finally:
    s.run(['git','worktree','remove','--force',w],capture_output=True);shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
